title: ChatRoomInsightResult
description: chat.room-insight-result@1: the answer of GET /api/v1/rooms/:id/insight on OpenVibe.Chat, public (no account, as the room itself is readable). One shape for every room: Global (id `global`) first, then a server's channels and the rooms people make. The overview is the summary OpenVibe.Chat's chat-AI job keeps (the same schedule, window and budget rules as Live's, only when there were new messages); it reads only the messages of people who allowed AI use of them (network.consent@1, purpose ai.train on kind chat), so an overview never quotes someone who did not. state is `ready` when the overview is fresh, `quiet` when there is nothing new to say (text and topics empty, the timeline keeps history), and `off` when the room's owner has not turned the insight on (private rooms; never a DM). A room the rollout does not cover answers 404. Timestamps are Chat's UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (ov_now()), or null.

text.description: The overview written for someone arriving now, in plain prose; empty when state is quiet or off.

count.description: How many messages of the window mentioned the topic.

topics.description: The words the window kept coming back to, most mentioned first. Empty when state is quiet or off.

people.description: How many different people wrote in the window the overview reads.

messages.description: How many messages the window held (the ones the summariser was allowed to read).

to.description: The window's last time, which is when the job last looked.

updated_at.description: When the overview row was last written.

at.description: When it happened, Chat's UTC `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.

kind.description: What kind of moment: `moment` for a notable thing the summariser recorded, `event` for a non-chat activity (a donation, a clip), `message` for a line it picked out.

message_id.description: The message it came from, when it is one message; null for a summary of several.

timeline.description: The room's notable moments, newest first. History survives a quiet window.

state.description: ready: the overview above is fresh. quiet: nothing new to say; said as quiet, never invented. off: the room's owner has not turned insight on.
